literal: On guisi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office captured Zubu chiefs Paisage, Pulu, and others who came to present captives.
idiomatic: On guisi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office captured Zubu chiefs Paisage, Pulu, and others who came to present captives.

literal: Eleventh month, on yisi day Tide Tonggua, Zubu Dilie, and others came to surrender.
idiomatic: On yisi day of the eleventh month Tide Tonggua, Zubu Dilie, and others came to surrender.

literal: Daridi and Basimu again came to invade; Northern Mountain deputy deployment Arudai defeated them.
idiomatic: Daridi and Basimu again came to invade; Northern Mountain deputy deployment Arudai defeated them.

literal: Twelfth month, on guiyou day Sanhe County commoner Sun Bin and his wife were both one hundred years old; their household was remitted.
idiomatic: On guiyou day of the twelfth month Sanhe County commoner Sun Bin and his wife were both one hundred years old; their household was remitted.

literal: On jiaxu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Tingmu also associate administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate privy commissioner Wang Shiru Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Tingmu was also made associate administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate privy commissioner Wang Shiru Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

literal: On jimao day, edict ordered recording meritorious officers and those killed in battle in the Northwest Route and posthumously granting office.
idiomatic: On jimao day an edict ordered recording meritorious officers and those killed in battle in the Northwest Route and posthumously granting office.

literal: On yiyou day, edict changed the coming year's era name, reduced mixed offenses from capital crime downward, and still remitted rent and tax for poor people.
idiomatic: On yiyou day an edict changed the coming year's era name, reduced mixed offenses from capital crime downward, and still remitted rent and tax for poor people.

literal: On wuzi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Mogusi.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Mogusi.
